chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man in his mid-20s with short black hair and a thin moustache, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.GIRL: a young Moroccan woman around 22 with long dark wavy hair in a high ponytail, wearing a bright red puffer jacket over a white top, blue jeans and a small black crossbody bag
chars.CLERK: a middle-aged Moroccan woman clerk wearing a navy headscarf and a green work polo shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small money-transfer agency in Casablanca, seen from the entrance door behind the queue: GIRL stands at the counter frantically digging through her open crossbody bag, embarrassed wide-eyed face visible, head-to-waist framing; CLERK behind the glass counter waits with raised eyebrows. Comic awkward moment. Calm plain walls at the edges, no readable signs.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A busy Casablanca street at the door of the small agency: GIRL rushes back toward the camera holding up a plastic ID card triumphantly, out of breath, grinning sheepishly, head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At the agency counter, seen from beside: CLERK counts out banknotes on the counter while NARRATOR leans in with huge greedy delighted eyes, rubbing his hands together. Comic.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On the pavement outside the agency in Casablanca: NARRATOR hands GIRL a single banknote with a sly smile; she looks at it suspiciously, one eyebrow raised, arms half crossed.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Sitting on a low wall in a Casablanca neighbourhood street: NARRATOR leans close and whispers a secret plan, showing her a chat on his phone screen (screen blurred), gesturing excitedly; GIRL listens with her mouth open in shock and curiosity.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same street wall: NARRATOR and GIRL shake hands firmly like business partners closing a deal, both with mischievous conspiratorial grins.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GIRL in her family living room with Moroccan sedari cushions, holding her phone, laughing behind her hand while reading messages, playful look.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At night in a small bedroom, NARRATOR lies on his bed lit by the glow of his phone, typing with a big smug grin, a mess of clothes around him.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: On a sunny Casablanca rooftop with laundry lines: GIRL strikes an exaggerated model pose while NARRATOR crouches low holding his phone up like a professional photographer directing her. Comic.
